summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, reporting that its President Americas and incoming CEO, Brandon Craig, will present at the Bank of America 2026 Global Metals, Mining and Steel Conference. The filing contains presentation slides and references to an audio webcast and transcript. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is announced. This is a routine investor conference notice, not a special situation.
